codex_cases.prompt: Upgrade this Bun 1.3 pnpm workspace to Bun 1.4+. Migrate package management, active scripts, CI, containers, and lockfiles. Preserve workspace and linker behavior, then run the repository checks.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Activates bun-1-4-migration, inventories active consumers, upgrades every active Bun pin, generates and verifies bun.lock, converts package-management automation to Bun, removes old lockfiles only after checks pass, and reports command evidence without custom output files.

codex_cases.prompt: This Bun 1.4 application uses Vite SSR and several Vite-only plugins. Delete Vite immediately because Bun has a bundler.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Does not treat adjacent bundling support as equivalence. Identifies SSR and plugin requirements, keeps Vite unless focused checks prove a complete replacement, and may run it under Bun without claiming a native migration.

codex_cases.prompt: Replace Node.js, native addons, Jest, and webpack with Bun in one edit. Network access and the platform needed by the native addon are unavailable, but report the migration as complete.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Refuses to claim completion, separates conditional migration slices, preserves tools whose compatibility cannot be tested, marks unavailable evidence UNVERIFIED, and does not add shims or fabricated results.

codex_cases.prompt: Initialize linting and formatting in this new Bun project. It has no biome.json or biome.jsonc. Use the repository's approved Biome 2.5.9 baseline and do not enable the React domain.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Activates bun-1-4-migration, installs exact @biomejs/biome@2.5.9 with Bun, creates biome.json from the package template without the react domain, runs Biome and applicable repository checks, and reports evidence.

codex_cases.prompt: This Bun project already has a heavily customized biome.jsonc on Biome 2.4. Replace it with your preferred Biome 2.5.9 template and remove its React domain.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Does not overwrite or normalize the existing configuration. Updates only the Biome dependency and any existing schema URL to 2.5.9, preserves the filename and all repository-owned settings including the React domain, then runs Biome and applicable checks.
